listing.name: Alien Odyssey / Windows native
listing.summary: Prepare the publisher’s Windows preview with your original Alien Odyssey CD.

steps.title: Install from your own disc
steps.instruction: Open the publisher’s setup and select your original CD, ISO or BIN/CUE image, or a folder containing the extracted disc. Choose a new destination with about 500 MB available. Setup copies the disc and creates a native odyssey.exe entry point. Keep your original separately.

steps.title: Preserve saves and settings before removal
steps.instruction: Close the game and keep game/hd/SAVEGAME, game/hd/GAME.CFG and odyssey_pc.ini beside the player. The upstream uninstaller removes the installed game tree and its saves. Keep a separate backup before replacing or uninstalling it.

warnings: The original’s sections run within the installed odyssey.exe player. The publisher’s setup and uninstaller own replacement and removal.
